scientific_integrity: Every claimed universal constant is justified analytically by matching lower witness and explicit Gram upper certificate. Floating-point checks are supplementary; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric sign matrices with negative entries confined to k diagonal positions, acting on complex spectral-operator-norm matrices; arbitrary sign symbols and other Schatten norms are excluded. Older priority may remain undiscovered. Prior small spectra and circulant subcase are not claimed original.
title: Sharp Schur norms for partially flipped diagonal sign matrices
